title.zh: 錯過朋友生日的道歉信

subtitle: 錯過好友的生日聚餐，寫信道歉並提議補請
task: You missed your close friend Lily's birthday dinner last week without telling her in advance. Write an email to her. Apologize sincerely, explain what happened, and suggest a way to make it up to her.
taskZh: 你上週錯過了好友 Lily 的生日晚餐，事前也沒告訴她。寫一封 email 給她：真誠道歉、說明發生了什麼事，並提議一個彌補的方法。
focus: 真誠道歉，說明原因但不推卸責任
語氣溫暖，適合寫給好友
時態正確（過去完成式、should have）

en: I owe you a big apology. I completely missed your birthday dinner last Friday, and I have felt terrible about it ever since. I know you had booked a table for all of us weeks ago, so I can only imagine how disappointed you must have been when I didn't show up.

I don't want to make excuses, but I would like to explain what happened. That afternoon, my manager asked me to stay late to fix a problem with a client's order. By the time I finished, it was almost ten o'clock, and my phone had died, so I couldn't even call you. It was careless of me not to tell you earlier that I might be late.
You have been one of my closest friends since high school, and the last thing I want is for you to think that our friendship isn't important to me. It is, and I should have shown it.

To make it up to you, I'd love to take you out for a belated birthday meal at that Thai restaurant you've been wanting to try. Are you free next Saturday evening? If not, just tell me a day that works for you, and I'll arrange everything.
Once again, I'm truly sorry. I hope you can forgive me.
zh: 我欠你一個大大的道歉。上週五我完全錯過了你的生日晚餐，從那之後我一直覺得很過意不去。我知道你幾週前就幫大家訂好了位子，所以我完全能想像我沒出現時你有多失望。
我不想找藉口，但想跟你說明一下發生了什麼事。那天下午，主管要我留下來加班，處理一位客戶訂單的問題。等我忙完已經快十點了，手機又沒電，所以連打電話給你都沒辦法。沒有早點告訴你我可能會遲到，是我太粗心了。
你從高中起就是我最親近的朋友之一，我最不希望的就是讓你覺得我不重視我們的友誼。我很重視，而且我早該用行動表現出來。
為了彌補你，我想請你去那家你一直想去的泰式餐廳，補過一頓生日大餐。你下週六晚上有空嗎？如果沒空，就告訴我哪天方便，其他都交給我安排。
再說一次，我真的很抱歉。希望你能原諒我。
